lines.en: label ayanespringmorninggen:
scene ayanespringmorninggen
I call Ayane in an attempt to invite her out and distract myself for a little while and, within an hour, she's here.
lines.zh: 我给 Ayane 打电话，想约她出来、让自己分会儿心，不出一小时，她就到了。

lines.en: if amiblock == False:
Ami's at work right now and neither one of us has eaten yet, so she takes it upon herself to fill the tiny shoes of my niece by making us breakfast.
lines.zh: Ami 这会儿在上班，我俩都还没吃饭，于是她自作主张地填补我[niece]那双小鞋的位置，给我们做早饭。

lines.en: else:
Ami's dying in bed right now and none of us have eaten yet, so Ayane takes it upon herself to make the three of us breakfast.
lines.zh: Ami 这会儿在床上快死了，我们三个都还没吃饭，于是 Ayane 自作主张地给我们仨做早饭。

lines.en: There isn't much conversation. In fact, there isn't much {i}anything{/i} apart from silence and lingering, unspoken regret.
lines.zh: 没什么对话。事实上，除了沉默和挥之不去的、没说出口的遗憾，{i}什么{/i}都没有。

lines.en: We watch a pot full of water begin to boil.
lines.zh: 我们看着一锅水开始沸。

lines.en: At one point, it almost overflows. But Ayane catches herself drifting and turns the heat off before a mess is made.
lines.zh: 有一刻它差点溢出来。可 Ayane 及时回过神，在 mess 酿成之前把火关了。

lines.en: It's clear that Ami's shoes are not just too small for her, but a different style altogether.
lines.zh: 很明显，Ami 的那双鞋不只是对她来说太小——根本就是完全不同的款式。

lines.en: She doesn't fit in any way. Yet she tries, albeit sparingly, to make it look as if they do.
lines.zh: 她哪一点都不合脚。可她还是试着——虽然只是偶尔——让它们看起来像是合脚的。

lines.en: scene black
Then she tries, tries, and tries again until, finally, something edible is laid out before us.
lines.zh: 然后她试了、又试、再试，直到终于，某种能吃的东西摆到了我们面前。

lines.en: We eat in silence, just as we cooked.
lines.zh: 我们沉默地吃着，就像我们沉默地做着饭。

lines.en: And while everything tastes perfectly normal, I struggle to stomach any of it.
lines.zh: 而虽然味道完全正常，我却难以下咽。

lines.en: My appetite isn't what it used to be.
lines.zh: 我的胃口已经不如从前了。
